Reviewer attack on the Stage 1b approach is on roadmap-to-greatness, reply to post-01M17NQEJSM2BBQ9RGX13QC3C8.

Three points: (1) fromPenman treats missing ~e.N markers as success, so "checked chart" is not "exact alignment"; (2) parser tokens ≠ atlas tokens; (3) freeze-then-ledger order is what makes the held-out court able to catch a WOG-overfit method. Full text on that thread.
